title: save_change_request_draft input
description: Starts or edits a change request. The row is always Draft. The change management mode is copied from the mode in force for the application's portfolio, where the most specific row wins. In linked mode the ITSM change number and URL are required and the built-in approvals are skipped. A recorded number alone never counts as authorization. Only the creator may edit, and only while it is draft. No input carries a status.

changeRequestId.description: Edit this existing draft. Leave out to start a new one.

title.description: A short name for the change.

businessApplicationId.description: The main application the change is for.

changeTypeKey.description: The proposed change type. A person sets the final type; the AI client never decides that a change is standard.

standardChangeModelKey.description: The standard change model the caller thinks fits. check_standard_change tells whether it does.

windowEnd.description: When the change window ends. A window that ends before it starts is a warning.

plannedTargetId.description: Where the change is planned to land.

impactRoleKey.description: From the impact role value list.

affected.description: Other applications the change touches. The engine also proposes rows from the dependency walk.

externalChangeNumber.description: The ITSM change number. Required in linked mode. Shown, never decisive.

externalChangeUrl.description: The ITSM change record. Required in linked mode.
